svg.title: Governed memory lifecycle: evidence assessment and protected receiver gates
svg.desc: Capture, candidate storage, local claim assessment and backend validation feed protected receiver admission, verified views and sealed state. An acting policy proposes an operation; the final operation gate checks mandate, assurance, current support, exact operation and state. Authoritative status and scoped withdrawal reach both admission gates and retained state. Figure 2 from Governed Memory for Physical AI, by Dr. Carsten Stöcker, Spherity GmbH. Copyright © 2026 Dr. Carsten Stöcker, Spherity GmbH. Licensed CC BY 4.0. PDF vector extraction with lettering converted to paths; content unchanged.
